note: The wide wooden jetty at the far end of the harbour, low camera on the planks; landmark: the towering coral-and-white cruise ship along the left with its escalator gangway (repainted so it no longer looks like R_harbour_01; gate 13). Feminine LEFT: passengers riding the escalator gangway down at the stopover (escale), otter in sunglasses on a deckchair on the jetty (jetée), anchor going down from the blue boat with a crab riding it (ancre); maritime (adj): four otters rowing past the signal-flag mast. Masculine RIGHT: seal clapping on the planks (phoque), newcomer with suitcase handed flowers (arrivant), penguin navigator with map at a ship's wheel (navigateur). Exception: the container ship (la container, f) sits on the horizon far right, the only open sea in view. Exits: fingerpost near left -> R_harbour_01; stone steps right -> the cove R_harbour_02_z1. Painted 2026-10-22.
